title: Architecture Test Receipt
description: Integrity/freshness receipt for one architecture-contract check, committed alongside evidence.md. It is the sole source of truth the arch:<ContractId> marker pure-parses. It proves a real run happened at a recorded tree-state and carries the taxonomy verdict; it is NOT an anti-forgery signature (the trust anchor is the human-authored commit + git review). Freshness binds to sourcesHash (contract + target sources), not raw HEAD equality, so committing the receipt does not self-invalidate it.

contractId.description: Id of the contract this receipt attests.

maturity.description: Contract maturity at run time. Governs the taxonomy-to-gate mapping.

adapter.description: Enforcement backend that produced the verdict.

verdict.description: Failure-taxonomy outcome. For a locked contract only 'pass' greens; 'skip-absent-toolchain' never counts as pass (no false-green).

ran.description: True only when the adapter actually executed. False for skip-absent-toolchain / pre-execution errors.

parentCommit.description: Recorded parent-commit SHA (HEAD at run time; 40-hex SHA-1 or 64-hex SHA-256), treated as the parent commit for freshness reasoning.

sourcesHash.description: Canonical tree/content hash of the contract + target sources. Freshness compares this, so adding/editing/deleting a source invalidates the receipt while committing the receipt itself does not.

findings.description: Optional structured violations reported by the adapter.

artifacts.description: Optional paths to raw adapter output (TRX/JUnit/JSON).

lockDecision.description: Lock-gate outcome that produced this verdict. Distinguishes a deliberate draft/provisional skip ('skip-not-locked') from an absent toolchain, and surfaces 'lock-invalidated' drift (a locked body whose recomputed hash no longer matches lockedBodySha256) so review can flag it.
